svg.title: ContainerSSH microkernel architecture
svg.desc: Structural diagram of ContainerSSH's microkernel architecture: a stable SSH server core with shared infrastructure assembled in factory.go, extended by replaceable Docker, Kubernetes, and SSH proxy backends selected via config.AppConfig.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does an SSH client connect to ContainerSSH?')
sendPrompt('What does the ContainerSSH SSH server handle?')
sendPrompt('What do ContainerSSH health checks do?')
sendPrompt('How does ContainerSSH audit logging work?')
sendPrompt('How does config.AppConfig drive backend selection?')
sendPrompt('How does the ContainerSSH Docker backend work?')
sendPrompt('How does the ContainerSSH Kubernetes backend work?')
sendPrompt('How does the ContainerSSH SSH proxy backend work?')
sendPrompt('What containers does Docker backend launch?')
sendPrompt('What pods does the Kubernetes backend launch?')
sendPrompt('What host does the SSH proxy forward to?')
